summary: The commenter proposes deterministic, fixed-field cryptographic binding (an 'IdentHash') to link an on-chain wallet address to the legally relevant off-chain shareholder record while keeping personal information off-chain, and a deterministic cross-ledger transaction reference to support reconciliation with the master securityholder file when the same securities exist on multiple distributed ledgers. The commenter does not ask the Commission to mandate a particular algorithm. This is the commenter's position, not an SEC or TitleChain Foundation conclusion.
